## Dublin Dental Cleaning Booking Snapshot

A good match for your needs is a **general dental clinic in Dublin with Saturday hours**, offering a **scale and polish / standard cleaning**, optional **X-ray if clinically needed**, and an **initial visit price within EUR 90–140**. Since you have no urgent issues, the main goal is to confirm **availability within 30 days** and whether the first appointment includes a consultation.

## Clinic Comparison Checklist for a Standard Cleaning

| Check | What to confirm | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| Appointment window | Can they see you **within 30 days**? | Keeps the booking on track |
| Saturday availability | Do they offer **Saturday slots**? | Matches your preferred schedule |
| Price range | Is the first visit **EUR 90–140**? | Fits your budget |
| Cleaning scope | Does the visit include a **standard cleaning / scale and polish**? | Confirms the core service |
| X-ray option | Can they do an **X-ray if needed** at the same visit? | Avoids a second appointment |
| Consultation included | Does the initial visit include a **consultation/exam**? | Clarifies what you’re paying for |
| Cancellation policy | What is the **notice period** and fee for changes? | Prevents surprise charges |
| New patient process | Do they accept **adult new patients** and what ID/medical details are needed? | Speeds up booking |

## Booking Message You Can Send

Hello,

I’m an adult patient looking to book a **routine dental cleaning** in Dublin within the next **30 days**. I have **no urgent issues** and would like to know if you have **Saturday availability**.

I’m looking for a clinic that can provide:
- A **standard cleaning / scale and polish**
- An **X-ray if needed**
- A first-visit total in the range of **EUR 90–140**

Could you please confirm:
- Your **next available appointment dates**, especially Saturdays
- Whether the **initial visit includes a consultation/exam**
- Your **pricing** for the cleaning and any X-rays
- Your **cancellation or rescheduling policy**
- Whether you accept **new adult patients**

Thank you.

## Questions to Ask Before You Book

- What is the total price for the **first appointment**?
- Does that price include a **consultation and examination**?
- If an X-ray is needed, is it **included or charged separately**?
- Is the cleaning a **scale and polish**, and how long does it usually take?
- Do you have **Saturday appointments** in the next 30 days?
- What is your **cancellation policy** and required notice period?
- Are there any **extra fees** for new patients, records, or follow-up visits?

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Find clinics] https://www.google.com/search?q=dental+clinic+Dublin+Saturday+cleaning+X-ray+new+patients
Action: [Button: Compare prices] https://www.google.com/search?q=Dublin+dental+clinic+price+scale+and+polish+consultation
Action: [Button: Check reviews] https://www.google.com/search?q=Dublin+dental+clinic+reviews+Saturday

## Sources

- HSE dental care overview: https://www2.hse.ie/services/dental-services/
- Citizens Information on health services: https://www.citizensinformation.ie/en/health/health-services/
- General dental regulator info in Ireland: https://www.dentalcouncil.ie/
